resources.string: Use your own photos in Sliding Tiles with Pro.
Your saved photo is kept. Pro is needed to show it; you can keep playing with numbers.
A private copy stays on this device and in your backups. Delete saved copies in Settings → Saved photos.
The center of your photo becomes the puzzle. Orientation is kept; animated images use a still frame. Your moves and score stay the same.
This saved photo could not be opened. Your puzzle is safe; choose another photo or use the default artwork.
The photo could not be saved. Try a smaller image, check that Pro is available, or delete saved photos in Settings if storage is full.
Watch a verified solution from the starting board. Your own puzzle is saved. Demonstrations earn no stars, points, streaks or achievements.
The way is clear. Return to try your own approach.
This demonstration could not be opened. Your puzzle is safe.
Practice · Your saved daily best stays as it is.
A scored daily attempt. Your best counts separately from campaign progress.
Practice complete. No stars or points added.
This puzzle is no longer available through your current access. Your saved progress is safe. Return to choose another puzzle.
This saved puzzle could not be opened. Please try again.
Traffic Jam board, six rows and six columns. Exit on the right of row three.
Drag a piece to move it. Legal spaces light up while dragging. You can also tap to choose.
Your board and timer will start over. Your personal best stays saved.
Your board is saved. Come back whenever you like.
Your timer is paused. Your puzzle will be here.
We could not save that change. Your last saved board is safe.
Your daily hints are used. More will be ready tomorrow.
The way is clear. Slide piece %1$s through the exit.

plurals.name: play_hint_recover
plurals.item: Undo %1$d move to return to a known solution route.
Undo %1$d moves to return to a known solution route.

resources.string: A hint is not available for this position.
A hint helped along the way. This attempt can earn up to two stars.
Board overview. Tap to move the magnified view.
Piece A wants to leave through the right side. Tap the terracotta piece to select it.
Piece B is in the way. Tap B to see where it can move.
Slide B down to row 4, or tap destination 4 below the board. Each slide counts as one move, however far it goes.
The path is open. Select A, then tap Exit to slide it out.
You have the idea. In a puzzle, Undo lets you try another approach. A hint suggests a move on a known route. Your progress saves with every move.
That move is not available. Try another position.
Move the top disk from peg %1$d to peg %2$d.
Ten disks can take several visits. Your board is saved after every move.
Peg %1$d. Disks from top to bottom: %2$s.
Drag a top disk to a highlighted peg, or tap a peg to select it.
Peg %1$d selected. Choose a destination. A larger disk cannot rest on a smaller disk.
Toggle this light and its neighbours
Full %1$d by %1$d board. %2$d lights on. Tap the overview to move the view; use the large squares to toggle.

plurals.name: play_jugs_goal
plurals.item: Measure exactly %1$d unit in any jug.
Measure exactly %1$d units in any jug.

resources.string: Choose a jug to fill, empty, or pour.
Jug %1$d selected. Pouring stops when it is empty or the other jug is full.
Sort the stack, smallest at the top.
You know the first moves. Take your time with your own puzzle. This practice has not changed your progress.
Choose peg 1 to pick up its smallest, top disk.
Choose peg 3 to place the disk. You can move only one top disk at a time.
Now move the top disk from peg 1 to peg 2. A larger disk cannot rest on a smaller one.
Move the small disk from peg 3 onto peg 2. Keep making space until the whole tower reaches the goal peg.
Tap row 1, column 1. It changes that light and the neighbours directly beside it.
Tap row 2, column 2. A middle square changes five lights: itself, above, below, left and right.
Tap row 3, column 3 to turn the last lights off. A hollow circle means off.
Choose jug 1, which holds three units.
Tap Fill. Filling always takes a jug to its full capacity.
Choose jug 1 again, then pour into jug 2. The smaller jug fills, leaving exactly one unit behind.
Use Fewer or More to choose the top %1$d pancakes, then tap Flip. Everything above the line reverses order.
The demonstration is complete. Return to try your own approach.
Put the tiles in order, with the empty square at the bottom right.
Slide block %1$s through the bottom opening, below columns %2$d–%3$d.
Push a box onto every ring. Boxes cannot be pulled.
Whole board, %1$d columns and %2$d rows. Tap to position the magnified view without making a move.
Slide tile %1$d into the empty square.
Slide a neighbouring tile into the gap, or tap the tile and then the gap.
The complete picture: two potted plants on a wooden sill, with a blue window and a golden sun.
Block %1$s, row %2$d, column %3$d. %4$d columns wide and %5$d rows tall.
Drag a block to move it. You can also select a block and tap a destination dot.
Walk to row %1$d, column %2$d without pushing.
Tap floor to walk. Tap an adjacent box to push. Undo adds one scored push.
● You · □ Box · ○ Goal · ▣ Box on goal
A box cannot reach a goal from here. Undo to make space again, or ask for a recovery hint.
Choose tile %1$d, then tap the empty square or Slide. Only a neighbouring tile can move into the gap.
Choose block B. Move its top-left corner to row 3, column 1 to clear a path.
Choose block A and move it to row 1, column 2. One straight slide counts as one move, however far it goes.
Choose A again, then slide it through the opening. Other blocks must stay inside the board.
Tap the empty floor at row 3, column 2, just below you. Walking finds an open path and never pushes a box.
Tap the box next to you, or the right arrow, to push it one square. A push counts toward your score.
Push right once more to place the box on the ring. Boxes can be pushed, but never pulled. Undo can recover a trapped box.
Leave one peg in the ring at row %1$d, column %2$d.
Jump from row %1$d, column %2$d to row %3$d, column %4$d.
Choose a peg, then an empty hole two spaces away. The peg you jump over is removed. Drag works too.
No jump remains. Undo to try another route, or ask for a recovery hint.
Place %d queens so none share a row, column or diagonal.
Place a queen at row %1$d, column %2$d.
Remove the queen at row %1$d, column %2$d.
Tap an empty square to place a queen; tap it again to remove it. Underlined queens stay fixed. Crossed squares are unavailable.
Visit every square once, moving two squares one way and one sideways.
Visit every square once. The final square must be a knight move from the first.
Dots mark possible next squares. Tap one to continue. Undo counts as a backtrack, even if you redo it.
This route cannot continue. Undo a step, or ask for a recovery hint.
Bring everyone safely to the right bank.
W is the wolf, G the goat, C the cabbage. You row with one passenger or alone. Without you, the wolf eats the goat and the goat eats the cabbage.
M are missionaries, C are cannibals. Wherever missionaries are present, cannibals cannot outnumber them, on either bank or in the boat.
A1 and B1 form a pair, and so on. A B traveller cannot be with another pair\'s A traveller unless their own A partner is there. This applies to both banks and the boat.

Numbers show each person\'s crossing minutes. One or two people carry the torch; a pair takes the slower person\'s time. Someone must bring the torch back. Undo adds the reversed crossing\'s minutes to your score.
That party cannot cross safely. Change the selection.
Select travellers beside the boat or torch, then confirm the crossing. Selected tokens have a thick border.
Choose the peg at row %1$d, column %2$d. Jump to the empty hole at row %3$d, column %4$d.
The underlined queen stays in place. Tap row %1$d, column %2$d to add a queen without an attack.
Move in an L shape to row %1$d, column %2$d. A square can be visited only once; undo lets you change your route.
Select G, the goat, then Cross right. The wolf and cabbage can wait together.
Leave the goat on the right. With no passenger selected, choose Cross left to row back alone.
Select C, the cabbage, then Cross right. You will need return trips to keep both banks safe.
